task: Review an identical public layout: intent constraints, changed masks, ambiguous targets, stale electrical evidence and a reproducible handoff report
baseline: KLayout GUI plus direct Python scripting/extensions; evaluator scripts provided, not default GUI alone
design: Counterbalanced within-participant task order; three practicing analog/layout engineers for an initial pilot, followed by a larger agreed study
same_conditions: same PDK and native engine versions
same acceptance criteria and planted faults
same training time and access to scripts
independent answer key fixed before recording

tasks.expected: accept only the explicit mask scope, no foundry approval
detect a 5 DBU move and new protected-region geometry
withhold judgment when stable target correspondence is lost
link actual same-revision finite OTA evidence and refuse incomplete PVT/old simulations
another engineer reopens the report and identifies sources, engine inputs and unresolved requirements

raw_session_required: consented pseudonymous participant ID and relevant experience
tool order and exact task revision

provisional_pilot_gate.time_claim: only compute paired raw times after real sessions; a small pilot does not establish market superiority

interpretation: The automated KLayout fixture comparison establishes only code verdict agreement. It cannot fill participant times or customer value.
